bulletin.text: Morning of 20 September 2026. Fires detected on 19 September 2026 put 564 fires in Priority 1 in West Kalimantan. The ten fires at the top of the list carry 30% of the modelled smoke over residents. Fire 1, near Kayong Utara, carries 7.1% of it; 2,667,610 residents live within 40 km of its smoke path, and its smoke is heading NW, reaching Kubu Raya after 2 hours. Fire 2, near Ketapang, carries 3.7% of it; 2,767,117 residents live within 40 km of its smoke path, and its smoke is heading NW, reaching Kota Pontianak after 21 hours. Fire 3, near Ketapang, carries 3.3% of it; 2,155,290 residents live within 40 km of its smoke path, and its smoke is heading NW, reaching Kubu Raya after 6 hours. New in the top ten today: fires near Ketapang, Kayong Utara. This is a ranking index, not a forecast of smoke concentration. People outside Indonesia are not counted. The task force decides.
